title: Cofaces and codegeneracies generate every simplex morphism
statement: Let $W$ be a property of morphisms of the simplex category that contains all identities and is closed under composition. If $W$ contains every coface $\delta_i:[n]\to[n+1]$ and every codegeneracy $\sigma_i:[n+1]\to[n]$, then $W$ contains all morphisms.

proof.text: Apply SimplexCategory.morphismProperty_eq_top directly. Its IsMultiplicative hypothesis expresses identity and composition closure, and its two remaining hypotheses are exactly membership of the cofaces and codegeneracies.

mathlib_searches.query: A multiplicative property of simplex morphisms containing all cofaces and codegeneracies contains every simplex morphism

lemma morphismProperty_eq_top
    (W : MorphismProperty SimplexCategory) [W.IsMultiplicative]
    (δ_mem : ∀ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 2)), W (SimplexCategory.δ i))
    (σ_mem : ∀ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)), W (SimplexCategory.σ i)) :
    W = ⊤
